records.query: Apple 最近有什麼跟 Siri 有關的法律訴訟或和解消息？
records.answer:
Apple 最近因被指在廣告中誇大 Siri 的人工智慧功能而達成一項高達 **2.5 億美元（$250 million）** 的和解協議，將向符合條件的 iPhone 用戶每部最高支付 **$95**【AAPL_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #2】。  

- 這項和解是為了解決原告指稱 Apple 透過「Enhanced Siri features」的宣傳誤導消費者，促使他們購買 iPhone 16、iPhone 15 Pro 或 iPhone 15 Pro Max 等機型【AAPL_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #2】。  
- 受影響的約 **0.37 億（37 million）** 部 iPhone 持有人符合索賠資格，最初每部將收到 **$25**，最終金額視索賠數量與其他因素而定，但不會超過 **$95**【AAPL_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #2】。  
- 若法院批准，此和解金額將成為 Apple 歷史上規模最大的和解之一【AAPL_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #2】。

iPhone owners could receive up to $95 under a proposed $250 million settlement resolving claims that Apple misled customers about Siri's artificial intelligence features, according to a recent court filing. The class-action lawsuit, filed in federal court in the Northern District of California on behalf of U.S. consumers, claims that Apple deceived customers by marketing "Enhanced Siri features" that did not yet exist, leading them to buy iPhones based on false advertising. The plaintiffs are seeking a $250 million settlement payment, according to a recent court filing. If approved by a judge, it could rank among the largest settlements involving Apple. "Apple has reached a settlement to resolve claims related to the availability of two additional features," an Apple spokesperson said in an email to CBS News. "We resolved this matter to stay focused on doing what we do best, delivering the most innovative products and services to our users."
Clarkson Law Firm, a public interest law firm that filed the original lawsuit against Apple, said in a statement on Wednesday that the settlement would provide "timely relief to tens of millions of consumers nationwide."
Here's what to know about the recent settlement. Am I eligible? The settlement covers people who purchased an iPhone 16 model, iPhone 15 Pro or iPhone 15 Pro Max between June 10, 2024, and March 29, 2025. Approximately 37 million iPhone owners are eligible, according to the court filing. Customers will be notified by either email or mail if they can file a claim. An online social media campaign will also provide information about the settlement website and who is eligible, according to the court filing. How much money could I get? Eligible customers will initially receive $25 per device. Depending on how many claims are submitted and other determining factors, the final payment may increase or decrease, but it will not exceed $95 per device, according to the court filing
How do I file a claim? Claim filing details are not released yet. Clarkson Law Firm said on its
website
that a settlement website with more details will be available in "a few weeks."
According to the court filing, the website "will include all necessary information to learn about the settlement" and a number consumers can call with questions. Edited by
Aimee  Picchi
The Associated  Press
contributed to this report.

After two years of delays, Apple's (
AAPL
) reinvented Siri, Siri AI,
appears ready for primetime
. The company unveiled the AI-powered version of its assistant at its Worldwide Developers Conference in Cupertino, Calif., on Monday, saying it will launch, albeit as a beta, later this year. The update is designed to transform Siri from a glorified kitchen timer to a
digital helper for the AI age
. Apple said Siri AI will be able to pull context from your apps, allowing you to, say, ask it the name of a podcast your sister recommended via text and have it presented to you without opening any separate apps or services. The idea is for Siri AI to recognize what you want, when you want it, and surface it, whether it's content on your device or from the web. It's more or less what Apple promised when it showed off its AI-enhanced Siri and Apple Intelligence at WWDC 2024. And in early demos, Siri AI, which rides on Apple Intelligence, appears to deliver on Apple's initial vision for its reimagined Siri. And it's thanks, at least in part, to Google (
GOOG
,
GOOGL
). Siri gets Google brains
In January, Apple and Google signed an agreement for Apple to use the search giant's Gemini models to power its improved Siri. That gave Apple the high-powered AI models it needed to move Siri AI forward, after its own models fell short,
Bloomberg's Mark Gurman previously reported
. During a question and answer session following Apple's WWDC keynote, senior vice president of software engineering Craig Federighi explained how Apple uses Google's models to give Siri AI its smarts. The software chief was sure to point out that Siri AI isn't just a rebranded version of Google's own Gemini assistant. Federighi explained how the Gemini assistant uses Google's Gemini models, including Gemini Flash-Lite, Gemini Flash, Gemini Pro, and its Gemini Image models. When it comes to grounding those models in world knowledge, he said, Gemini takes advantage of Google Search. Apple, Federighi said, uses none of those things. "We use none of the models that Google deploys to their customers, nor do we use the infrastructure and means by which they employ models to their customers," he explained.

records.query: Apple 在最近的 WWDC 上關於 Siri 有什麼新消息？
records.answer:
Apple 在本次 WWDC 上宣布了全新 AI 版 Siri（Siri AI），將於今年秋季以 beta 形式推出，並加入以 Google Gemini 模型為基礎的多項功能，強調個人化、隱私與安全。  

- Apple 在 WWDC 正式揭露 Siri AI，說明將在今年稍後以 beta 版上線，讓使用者先行體驗【AAPL_News_20260612_02.txt, chunk #0】。  
- Siri AI 能從使用者的 App 中提取上下文，讓使用者只要說出「我妹妹推薦的播客是什麼」就能直接呈現內容，無需開啟其他應用程式【AAPL_News_20260612_02.txt, chunk #0】。  
- 為了提升 AI 能力，Apple 與 Google 簽署協議，採用 Google 的 Gemini 系列模型（包括 Gemini Flash‑Lite、Gemini Flash、Gemini Pro 以及 Gemini Image）為 Siri AI 提供運算核心【AAPL_News_20260612_02.txt, chunk #0】。  
- 這些 Gemini 模型會利用 Google Search 進行世界知識的 grounding；但 Apple 明確表示不使用 Google 向客戶部署的模型或其基礎設施【AAPL_News_20260612_02.txt, chunk #0】。  
- Siri AI 會整合於 Apple Intelligence 平台，未來將在 Safari 瀏覽器、Password 與 Messages 應用中發揮作用，同時推出全新 Siri App 供使用者管理對話【AAPL_News_20260612_05.txt, chunk #0】。  
- 新版 Siri 以語音轉錄與即時問答為核心功能，提升使用者的互動體驗【AAPL_News_20260612_05.txt, chunk #0】。  
- 影片與文字說明指出，Beta 版將於秋季在美國先行以英文發布，並特別強調安全與隱私保護【AAPL_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #2】。  
- Apple 期待 Siri App 能與 ChatGPT、Grok、Gemini 等競爭對手抗衡，並提供由 Google 支援的 Search 或 Ask Prompt 功能【AAPL_News_20260612_03.txt, chunk #0】。  
- 同時，Apple 近期 iPhone 銷售在過去四個季度增長 16%，為 Siri AI 的推廣提供了堅實的硬體基礎【AAPL_News_20260612_03.txt, chunk #0】。

May 18 (Reuters) - Anthropic said on Monday it is revising its earlier position to allow users of its Mythos cybersecurity model ‌to share information about cyber threats with others who may be exposed ‌to similar vulnerabilities. Mythos, announced on April 7, is being deployed as part of Anthropic's "Project Glasswing," a controlled ​initiative under which select organizations, including major tech firms such as Amazon,
Microsoft
,
Nvidia
and
Apple
, are permitted to use the unreleased Claude Mythos Preview model for defensive cybersecurity purposes. Mythos' capabilities to code at a high level have given it a potentially ‌unprecedented ability to identify cybersecurity ⁠vulnerabilities and devise ways to exploit them, according to experts. Last week, Anthropic began telling partners that they are generally permitted to disclose ⁠their involvement in Glasswing and, at their own discretion, share findings, best practices, tools or code developed through the program. "We fully support our partners sharing findings with each ​other and ​companies outside of Glasswing to triage vulnerabilities," ​an Anthropic spokesperson said in a ‌statement. "While there was never a specific Glasswing NDA, confidentiality protections were something partners asked for at the outset and were built into agreements partners signed."
The protections were included in agreements with participating companies under which the model is provided, after partners sought assurances before sharing sensitive findings and expressed concern about being targeted by ‌attackers. "As the program has matured, we've adapted them ​to ensure key information can be shared broadly - ​including outside the program - for maximum ​defensive impact," the spokesperson added.

records.query: 最近有什麼跟 Tesla 或 Elon Musk 相關、影響 Tesla 關注度的新聞？
records.answer:
最近的新聞顯示，Elon Musk 因對 OpenAI 提出的 **1500 億美元** 訴訟被陪審團全體駁回、SpaceX 即將於 6 月 12 日在納斯達克上市，以及對科技股的拋售導致 **Tesla (TSLA)** 股價下跌，這些事件共同提升了市場對 Tesla 的關注度【NVDA_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #1】【TSLA_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #0】【NVDA_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #0】。  

- **OpenAI 訴訟結果**：陪審團認為 Musk 等人提起訴訟的時效已過，駁回了他對 OpenAI 及其領導人 Sam Altman 的 1500 億美元索賠，並同時裁定對 Microsoft (MSFT) 的相關指控亦超出時效【NVDA_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #1】。此案的結束為 Tesla 帶來大量媒體曝光，因 Musk 同時是 Tesla 的領導人。  

- **SpaceX IPO 動態**：SpaceX 預計以 **每股 135 美元** 的價格在納斯達克上市，目標估值 **17,700 億美元（$1.77 兆）**，若成功將成為美國第七大市值公司；該公司在 2025 年錄得 **44.94 億美元** 淨虧損【TSLA_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #0】。SpaceX 的上市計畫直接牽動投資人對 Musk 旗下所有企業（包括 Tesla）的關注。  

- **科技股拋售影響**：在 SpaceX IPO 前夕，對沖基金拋售包括 Nvidia、Apple、Amazon、Alphabet、Meta、Tesla 及 Microsoft 在內的「Magnificent Seven」股票，相關 ETF 自 6 月 5 日以來下跌超過 **2.4%**，其中 Tesla 股價亦隨之走低【NVDA_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #0】。此資金流向顯示投資者在關注 SpaceX 動向時，同時重新評估 Tesla 的市場定位。  

- **Tesla 本身的市場焦點**：Yahoo Finance 的分析影片指出，投資者將在本週關注 Tesla 的財報，並提到市場上有關可能併購的傳聞，儘管 Tesla 股價近期表現平淡，未見顯著波動【TSLA_News_20260721_01.txt, chunk #0】。  

- **Musk 個人形象的加持**：另一段影片稱 Musk 為「大想法之王」，強調其在太空、自由言論與多星球殖民等領域的遠見，間接提升大眾對其所領導公司的好奇與關注度【TSLA_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #3】。  

綜合以上，從訴訟結束、SpaceX IPO 計畫、相關科技股拋售以及即將公布的 Tesla 財報，近期所有與 Elon Musk 相關的新聞都在提升投資者與媒體對 Tesla 的注意力。

records.query: 新聞如何評價 Apple 服務業務的成長與獲利能力？
records.answer:
新聞普遍認為 Apple 的服務業務正以雙位數的速度成長，且因高毛利特性大幅提升公司的整體獲利能力【AAPL_News_20260612_05.txt, chunk #1】。

- 服務收入在最新季創下 310 億美元（$31.0 billion） 的紀錄，較前季成長 16%，顯示服務部門的營收增速遠高於硬體【AAPL_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #4】。  
- 服務營收的雙位數成長也在 LTM（最近 12 個月）中體現，Apple 的整體營收年增率為 12.8%，其中服務貢獻顯著【AAPL_News_20260612_04.txt, chunk #1】。  
- 3 年平均而言，Apple 的服務營收年增率為 5.6%，雖低於部分高速成長的同業，但仍屬於正向成長區間【AAPL_News_20260612_04.txt, chunk #1】。  
- 分析師預期未來服務營收年增率可超過 14%，若實現將使公司毛利率突破 48%【AAPL_News_20260612_04.txt, chunk #2】。  

服務業務的高毛利特性直接提升了 Apple 的整體獲利指標：

- 受服務比重提升影響，Apple 的 TTM 毛利率升至 47.9%，較 FY2024 的 46.2% 以及 FY2019 的 38.2% 均有明顯上升【AAPL_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #5】。  
- 營業利益率（Operating margin）在 TTM 站在 32.6%，遠高於同業平均的 18.4%，其中服務的高利潤率是主要驅動因素【AAPL_News_20260612_04.txt, chunk #1】。  
- EBITDA 利潤率達 35.4%，在同業中僅次於 SNDK，顯示服務部門的貢獻使 Apple 的營運獲利力居前【AAPL_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #5】。  
- 槓桿自由現金流利潤率（Levered FCF margin）為 22.4%，領先所有比較對象，反映服務收入的高現金轉換率【AAPL_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #5】。  

此外，服務的定價能力亦被多篇報導肯定，Apple 能在服務生態系統內提升價格，顯示其在服務領域具備明顯的議價能力【AAPL_News_20260612_04.txt, chunk #1】。  

綜合上述，新聞一致指出 Apple 服務業務正以雙位數的增長率擴張，並透過高毛利與強大現金流轉化，顯著提升公司整體的獲利表現與估值溢價。

records.query: 新聞報導 Apple 為什麼被視為值得長期持有的股票？
records.answer:
Apple 被視為值得長期持有的股票，因為它擁有高毛利率與營運利潤率、龐大且持續增長的服務與 AI 收入、強勁的現金產生與資本回饋，以及穩固的生態系統與品牌護城河【AAPL_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #5】【AAPL_News_20260612_05.txt, chunk #1】。

- **高利潤率**：Apple 的 TTM 毛利率達 47.9%，較 FY2024 的 46.2% 上升，營運利潤率則維持在 32.6%【AAPL_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #5】。這些數字在同業中屬於領先水平，顯示其產品與服務組合具備高附加價值。  
- **強勁現金流與資本回饋**：TTM 自由現金流為 1,292 億美元（$129.2 billion），足以覆蓋 77 億美元（$7.7 billion） 的股息與 370 億美元（$37.0 billion） 的回購；公司持有 1,466 億美元（$146.6 billion） 現金與有價證券，淨現金位置正向且持續成長【AAPL_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #5】。此外，Apple 近年持續執行大規模的股份回購與股息發放，為投資人提供穩定的回報基礎【AAPL_News_20260612_05.txt, chunk #1】。  
- **服務與 AI 的持續成長**：服務部門因新健康功能與電池改進帶動可穿戴設備回到成長，同時服務收入呈雙位數增長，顯示高利潤的經常性收入正在擴大【AAPL_News_20260612_05.txt, chunk #1】。Apple Intelligence 與 Siri AI 的推出，預期將在多年度升級與貨幣化上進一步提升服務收入與使用者黏著度【AAPL_News_20260612_03.txt, chunk #0】。  
- **iPhone 銷售動能**：過去四季 iPhone 成長率達 16%，顯示在核心硬體仍具備顧客忠誠度與升級需求【AAPL_News_20260612_03.txt, chunk #0】。公司亦在 iPhone 上實施價格上調，展現服務生態系的定價權力【AAPL_News_20260612_04.txt, chunk #1】。  
- **堅固的生態系統與品牌護城河**：Apple 擁有龐大的安裝基礎與生態系鎖定效應，讓使用者在硬體、軟體與服務間形成高黏著度，進一步支撐長期營收與利潤的穩定性【AAPL_News_20260612_05.txt, chunk #1】。  
- **資本配置與未來展望**：公司採取紀律性的資本配置策略，持續投資於 AI、折疊螢幕手機與其他創新產品，且受到投資大戶如 Ken Griffin 的青睞，近期目標價被提升至 $365，顯示市場對其長期成長仍抱持正面預期【AAPL_News_20260612_05.txt, chunk #0】。  

綜合以上因素——高利潤率、充沛現金流與回饋、服務與 AI 的持續擴張、iPhone 的穩健需求、以及深厚的生態系統——使 Apple 成為具備長期投資價值的股票。

NVIDIA 最新財報的營收成長速度在提供的資料中未被揭露，無法直接給出具體數值【NVDA_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #4】。  

然而，與 IREN 的最新 AI 雲端合作案顯示 NVIDIA 在資料中心布局上已取得多項具體進展：

1. **大型長期合約**：NVIDIA 簽署了價值 **34 億美元（$3.4 billion）**、為期五年的 AI Cloud 合約，將隨 IREN 部署 GPU 而逐步生效【NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #1】。  
2. **電力與算力規模**：合作包括 **5 GW** 的 NVIDIA HGX‑aligned AI 基礎建設，目標在 2026 年建置 **480 MW**（約 150,000 顆 GPU），並於 2027 年擴至 **1,210 MW**（約 730 MW 正在建設）【NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #1】。  
3. **GPU 部署目標**：合約規定 NVIDIA 的權利在 IREN 部署 **600,000 GPU** 後全部歸屬，顯示雙方正共同推動大規模 GPU 佈局【NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #1】。  
4. **資金投入機制**：NVIDIA 獲得以 **$70** 每股的價格購買最多 **0.3 億（30 million）** 普通股的五年認購權，若全額行使將代表 **21 億美元（$2.1 billion）** 的潛在投資，進一步支撐其在 IREN 全球平台的基礎建設【NVDA_News_20260508_02.txt, chunk #0】。  
5. **地區布局**：合作聚焦於美國德州的 **2 GW** Sweetwater 站點，同時在西班牙、澳洲等地擴展電力與資料中心設施，利用當地的再生能源與政策優勢加速 AI 基礎建設【NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #3】。  

綜合以上，儘管缺乏 NVIDIA 本身的營收成長數據，該 AI Cloud 合約與相關電力、GPU 佈局計畫顯示 NVIDIA 正在透過大規模算力供應、長期資金承諾與全球多點資料中心擴張，強化其在 AI 資料中心市場的佈局與競爭力。

IREN Shares Jump as Nvidia Deal Sharpens Bitcoin Miner’s AI Pivot
$IREN
$NVDA

By: CryptoProwl
IREN Limited (NASDAQ:
$IREN
) shares jumped in after-hours trading on Thursday after the company announced a new Nvidia (NASDAQ:
$NVDA
) partnership that gives its AI infrastructure pivot a much larger public-market signal. The stock rose 27% to $72.28 after closing at $56.85, before pulling back to $69.45 at press time, still up more than 21%. The rally followed IREN’s disclosure of a five-gigawatt strategic partnership with Nvidia tied to the deployment of AI infrastructure across its global data center pipeline. Under the agreement, IREN issued Nvidia a five-year right to purchase up to 30 million ordinary shares at $70 per share. If fully exercised, the right would represent up to $2.1 billion of potential investment, subject to conditions including regulatory limits. The partnership is expected to focus on Nvidia-aligned DSX AI factory infrastructure, with future deployments centred around IREN’s two-gigawatt Sweetwater campus in Texas. IREN also announced a separate five-year, $3.4 billion AI Cloud contract with Nvidia for air-cooled Blackwell GPUs, with deployment expected within 60 megawatts of existing data centers at Childress and a targeted ramp beginning in early 2027. The update pushes IREN further away from the pure bitcoin-mining identity it carried when it operated as Iris Energy.

[NVDA] 490 MW of secured power in Spain
, a “gigawatt-scale development pipeline,” and a team of more than
50 people
across development, engineering, construction, and operations. Roberts said Spain offers “supportive AI policy, abundant renewables, lower build costs, and strong connectivity into broader European demand.”
In response to a question about moving the Spanish power position toward delivered compute, Draper said the sites are secured and the next steps are “final design permitting,” which he said is already well advanced at a number of sites, followed by construction. Draper added that IREN is already seeing “direct requests” for European capacity from existing and new customers. On APAC, Roberts said Australia shares market similarities with Texas, including the structure of the power market, land availability, transmission, fiber connectivity, and renewables. He said Texas has been “an easier place to do business,” but that IREN has continued incubating Australian projects and sees Australia as a “fantastic frontier” given demand constraints in APAC. records.answer:

records.query: Apple 目前的毛利率表現如何？加上新聞中 Evercore ISI 最新調升的目標價與評等，市場如何綜合看待這家公司？
records.answer:
Apple 目前的毛利率在最近的 TTM 期間達到 **47.9%**，為近年最高水平之一【AAPL_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #5】。  

- **毛利率走勢**：此 47.9% 的毛利率較 FY 2024 的 46.2% 以及 FY 2019 的 38.2% 均有明顯提升，顯示服務佔比上升正推高整體毛利【AAPL_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #5】。  
- **Evercore ISI 目標價與評等**：Evercore ISI 將 Apple 的目標股價上調至 **$365**（自 $330 提升），同時維持 **Outperform** 評等【AAPL_News_20260612_05.txt, chunk #0】。  
- **市場整體看法**  
  - **估值溢價**：Apple 目前以約 **33.5 倍** 的 forward P/E 交易，較同業普遍較高，投資人為其服務收入與品牌護城河支付溢價【AAPL_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #5】。  
  - **正面因素**：分析師看好服務收入持續成長（預期 >14%）以及毛利率有望突破 **48%**，認為這能支撐高估值【AAPL_News_20260612_04.txt, chunk #2】。  
  - **負面因素**：同時也有分析師指出，因美國司法部訴訟與歐盟《數位市場法》可能迫使 App Store 佣金模式調整，對主要利潤來源構成風險，可能導致 P/E 下修【AAPL_News_20260612_04.txt, chunk #2】。  
  - **綜合情緒**：市場對 Apple 的看法呈 **中性**，即在高毛利與服務增長的支撐下仍面臨監管與供應鏈不確定性的壓力【AAPL_News_20260612_04.txt, chunk #1】。  

總結而言，Apple 以接近 48% 的毛利率展現強勁盈利能力，且受到 Evercore ISI 上調目標價與維持 Outperform 評等的正面支持；然而，監管挑戰與供應鏈風險使得投資者的整體情緒保持謹慎中立。

,

and
Apple
, are permitted to use the unreleased Claude Mythos Preview model for defensive cybersecurity purposes. After two years of delays, Apple's (
AAPL
) reinvented Siri, Siri AI,
appears ready for primetime
. The company unveiled the AI-powered version of its assistant at its Worldwide Developers Conference in Cupertino, Calif., on Monday, saying it will launch, albeit as a beta, later this year. The update is designed to transform Siri from a glorified kitchen timer to a
digital helper for the AI age
. Apple said Siri AI will be able to pull context from your apps, allowing you to, say, ask it the name of a podcast your sister recommended via text and have it presented to you without opening any separate apps or services. The idea is for Siri AI to recognize what you want, when you want it, and surface it, whether it's content on your device or from the web. It's more or less what Apple promised when it showed off its AI-enhanced Siri and Apple Intelligence at WWDC 2024. And in early demos, Siri AI, which rides on Apple Intelligence, appears to deliver on Apple's initial vision for its reimagined Siri. And it's thanks, at least in part, to Google (
GOOG
,
GOOGL
). Siri gets Google brains
In January, Apple and Google signed an agreement for Apple to use the search giant's Gemini models to power its improved Siri. That gave Apple the high-powered AI models it needed to move Siri AI forward, after its own models fell short,
Bloomberg's Mark Gurman previously reported
. During a question and answer session following Apple's WWDC keynote, senior vice president of software engineering Craig Federighi explained how Apple uses Google's models to give Siri AI its smarts. The software chief was sure to point out that Siri AI isn't just a rebranded version of Google's own Gemini assistant. Federighi explained how the Gemini assistant uses Google's Gemini models, including Gemini Flash-Lite, Gemini Flash, Gemini Pro, and its Gemini Image models. When it comes to grounding those models in world knowledge, he said, Gemini takes advantage of Google Search. Apple, Federighi said, uses none of those things. "We use none of the models that Google deploys to their customers, nor do we use the infrastructure and means by which they employ models to their customers," he explained.

records.query: Meta 目前的毛利率如何？加上新聞中 Morgan Stanley 對其 AI 護城河與資本支出的評價，市場如何綜合看待 Meta 的 AI 投資？
records.answer:
Meta 目前沒有在提供的資料中揭露具體的毛利率數字【META_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #0】；不過，根據 Morgan Stanley 分析師 Brian Nowak 的評估，市場對 Meta 的 AI 投資呈現出「看好 AI 護城河與高利潤潛力」與「短期資金面出現賣壓」的混合觀感。

**Morgan Stanley 對 AI 投資的正面評價**  
- Nowak 指出，Meta 正在擴大 AI 相關的競爭護城河，預期 2027‑2028 年將投入約 **3,800 億美元（$380 billion）** 的資本支出，這些投資有望在 2028 年為每股盈餘 (EPS) 增加 **$1‑$3**【META_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #0】。  
- 他認為，若 Meta 的 AI 搜尋工具能保有 **10%** 的每日查詢變現率，僅憑 **100 億（10 billion）** 使用者就能產生 **超過 100 億美元（$10 billion）** 的年營收【META_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #0】。  
- 為追求高毛利收入，Meta 已開始推出分層訂閱方案，進一步提升高利潤率的營收來源【META_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #0】。  
- 基於上述因素，Morgan Stanley 仍將 Meta 列為「永續最佳」股票之一，並維持 **$775** 的目標價【META_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #0】。

**市場短期資金面的負面訊號**  
- 根據 JPMorgan 的資料，對於即將上市的 SpaceX，對沖基金在 6 月 5 日之後拋售了包括 **Meta** 在內的「Magnificent Seven」科技巨頭股票，導致相關 ETF 下跌超過 **2.4%**【NVDA_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #0】。此舉顯示投資人短期內對 Meta 等大型科技股持較為謹慎或看空的態度。

**綜合結論**

records.answer:
Tesla 的汽車業務毛利率在最近的報導中沒有提供具體數字或變化趨勢，資料中僅提到 Tesla 的股價走勢與市場情緒，未見毛利率相關資訊【TSLA_News_20260721_01.txt, chunk #0】。

records.query: NVIDIA 目前的淨利率（profit margin）水準如何？加上新聞中黃仁勳對中國市場開放 AI 晶片銷售的最新談話，這對輝達的 AI 晶片競爭定位透露什麼？
records.answer:
目前公開的資料未提及 NVIDIA 近期的淨利率（profit margin）數值【NVDA_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #4】。  

**中國市場開放的最新談話與競爭定位**  
- NVIDIA 執行長黃仁勳表示，中國最終會「逐步」開放高階 AI 晶片的市場，且 H200 晶片已取得對中國的授權銷售資格，但仍未與北京官員討論具體銷售計畫【NVDA_News_20260519_03.txt, chunk #0】。  
- 黃仁勳同時指出，NVIDIA 最頂級的 Blackwell 與即將推出的 Rubin 系列仍被中國禁售，顯示即使市場逐漸放寬，部分高階產品仍受限制【NVDA_News_20260519_03.txt, chunk #1】。  

**競爭環境**  
- NVIDIA 正面臨來自 Cerebras（新上市、主打不同形態的 AI 處理器）以及 AMD（即將推出競爭性的機架式伺服器系統）的加劇競爭【NVDA_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #4】。  
- 同時，NVIDIA 的主要客戶 Amazon（AMZN）與 Google（GOOG/GOOGL）也在自家開發 AI 晶片並向第三方客戶提供，形成來自客戶自身的競爭壓力【NVDA_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #4】。  

**綜合解讀**  
- 中國市場的「逐步」開放可能為 NVIDIA 帶來新的收入機會，特別是 H200 這類已授權的產品；然而，頂級 Blackwell 與 Rubin 系列仍受禁售，限制了高毛利產品的擴張空間。  
- 由於 Cerebras、AMD 以及客戶自研晶片的競爭持續升溫，NVIDIA 必須依賴其在高效能 AI 硬體領域的領先技術與生態系統，才能在多元競爭者環繞的市場中維持領先地位【NVDA_News_20260519_04.txt, chunk #0】。

Nvidia boss Jensen Huang expects China to eventually open its market to high-end US chips that can train and run artificial intelligence systems. But he did not discuss sales of the powerful H200 model with top officials in Beijing, the businessman told Bloomberg Television in an interview broadcast Monday. Huang travelled to the country last week with US President Donald Trump, who met Chinese President Xi Jinping. The superpowers are in a fierce race for AI supremacy, and the H200 chip had until recently been barred from sale in China by Washington over national security concerns. However, there is no sign that Chinese tech companies are buying them, as Beijing ramps up domestic chip development in a bid to challenge US dominance in the key sector. "H200s are licensed to sell to China.

[NVDA] But the Chinese government has to decide how much of their local market do they want to protect," Huang said. "My sense is that over time the market will open," added Huang, CEO of Nvidia -- the world's most valuable company, due to huge demand for its AI hardware. Trump said in December he had reached an agreement with Xi to ease the restrictions on H200 chips, a move some US lawmakers have warned could help the Chinese military. Nvidia's most top-of-the-range offerings, the Blackwell and forthcoming Rubin series, remain banned for sale in China. Xi told a delegation of US business executives on Thursday that China would "open wider" to the world.

records.query: NVIDIA 的核心技術護城河是什麼？
records.answer:
NVIDIA 的核心技術護城河在於其完整且高度整合的加速運算平台，結合領先的 GPU 硬體、廣泛的軟體堆疊與龐大的開發者與合作夥伴生態系統，使其能在資料中心、AI 訓練與推論、圖形與自動駕駛等多元高價值市場保持領先地位【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20】。

**主要構成要素**  

1. **GPU 硬體與架構領先**  
   - NVIDIA 以數萬顆運算核心的 GPU 為基礎，提供深度學習所需的平行處理能力，並在最新的 Blackwell 架構中加入 AI 專屬功能與神經圖形技術，讓同一套硬體同時支援資料中心與 PC 遊戲等多種工作負載【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20】、【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #28】。  
   - 其平台同時涵蓋 GPU、CPU、DPU 三大處理單元，形成端到端的加速計算解決方案【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #28】。

2. **完整的軟體堆疊與開發工具**  
   - CUDA 開發平台自 2006 年推出以來，已成為全球超過 0.075 億（7.5 百萬）開發者使用的基礎軟體，提供大量的函式庫、框架、SDK 與 API，讓各類應用能快速在 NVIDIA GPU 上部署【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20】、【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #28】。  
   - NVIDIA AI Enterprise 套件（含 NIM、NeMo、AI Blueprints）提供企業級的生成式 AI、模型微調與安全部署工具，進一步鞏固其在 AI 應用層面的領先【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #28】。  

3. **龐大的生態系與合作網路**  
   - 超過 0.075 億（7.5 百萬）開發者、數千所大學、數萬家新創公司（透過 Inception 計畫）以及主要伺服器製造商與雲端服務供應商共同使用 NVIDIA 的平台，形成高度黏著的生態系，提升切換成本與平台價值【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #28】。  
   - Deep Learning Institute 提供最新的 AI 設計與部署課程，持續培養技術人才並擴大平台影響力【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #28】。  

4. **持續的大規模研發投入**  
   - 自公司成立以來已投入超過 **767 億美元（$76.7 billion）** 的研發資金，確保在 GPU、AI 演算法與軟體工具方面保持創新領先【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20】。  

5. **端到端的應用解決方案**  
   - 在資料中心、專業視覺、汽車自動駕駛等領域提供從硬體、系統、軟體到模型與資料的完整堆疊，讓客戶能在單一平台上完成訓練、模擬與部署，進一步加深客戶依賴度【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #26】。  

綜合以上，NVIDIA 的護城河由硬體領先、軟體平台深度、廣大且活躍的開發者與合作夥伴網路，以及持續的大規模研發投入共同構成，形成難以被競爭者快速複製的競爭優勢。

records.query: NVIDIA 如何用同一套底層架構同時佈局資料中心、遊戲、專業視覺化與車用市場？
records.answer:
NVIDIA 以同一套可程式化的 GPU 與 CUDA 軟體平台為底層架構，讓其硬體、系統、軟體與 AI 生態同時服務資料中心、遊戲、專業視覺化與車用四大市場【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20】。  

- **底層可程式化架構**：NVIDIA 的 GPU 具備 CUDA 開發平台，搭配數千個領域專屬的軟體函式庫、框架、API 與演算法，形成統一的可程式化基礎，能在不同應用領域上重複使用【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20】。  
- **資料中心 (Compute & Networking)**：Compute & Networking 事業部提供資料中心加速運算與網路平台、AI 解決方案與軟體，並透過 NVLink、DPUs 等互連技術組成完整的 AI 基礎設施【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #24】、【NVDA_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #2】。  
- **遊戲與專業視覺化 (Graphics)**：Graphics 事業部以 GeForce GPU 服務 PC 與遊戲玩家，並以 Quadro/NVIDIA RTX GPU 為企業工作站提供高效能圖形渲染，這些 GPU 同樣內建 Tensor Core 與 AI 功能，讓遊戲與專業視覺化可直接受惠於同一套硬體與軟體堆疊【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #24】、【NVDA_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #2】。  
- **車用與自動駕駛**：在 Automotive 平台，NVIDIA 將相同的 GPU、CPU、DPU 以及 CUDA、Deep Learning SDK 等軟體工具整合為自動駕駛與電動車解決方案，讓車用系統能利用已在資料中心與遊戲領域驗證的 AI 加速能力【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #24】。  
- **平台策略與生態系**：NVIDIA 以「硬體 + 系統 + 軟體 + 演算法」的全端平台策略，將上述四大市場的需求映射到同一套底層技術上，並透過超過 750 萬開發者、數千家合作夥伴與大學、創業公司共同擴大生態系，使同一平台在不同垂直領域產生規模效應【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #28】。  

因此，NVIDIA 透過統一的 GPU 與 CUDA 為核心的可程式化架構，結合多樣化的硬體互連與完整軟體堆疊，讓資料中心、遊戲、專業視覺化與車用市場皆能共享同一平台的技術優勢與創新生態。

records.query: Microsoft 如何把 Copilot 整合進 Microsoft 365 的產品策略？
records.answer:
Microsoft 365 透過將 Copilot 內嵌於雲端訂閱服務、提升每位使用者平均收入與座位成長，將 AI 功能作為核心產品策略的一環【MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #52】、【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #105】。

- **產品組合整合**：Microsoft 365 Commercial 雲端收入的計算項目已明確列入「Microsoft 365 Copilot」以及其他服務（如 Enterprise Mobility + Security、Power BI、Exchange、SharePoint、Teams、Security and Compliance），顯示 Copilot 已被視為平台內不可分割的 AI 元件【MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #142】。  
- **AI‑驅動成長**：2026 年第一季（截至 2026‑03）Microsoft 365 Commercial 雲端收入較前期成長 19%，其中「Microsoft 365 Copilot」與 E5 方案的每位使用者收入提升是主要動力【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #105】。同時，Microsoft 365 Commercial 座位數增長 6%，部分來源於針對中小企業與前線員工的 Copilot 推廣【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #105】。  
- **跨產品線擴散**：Copilot 不僅限於商務版，亦納入 Windows 商業版的雲端部分以及 Microsoft 365 Consumer 服務，形成「AI‑first」的全套生產力與協作工具組合，支撐從 Office 到 Windows 再到 Power Platform 的端到端 AI 方案【MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #52】。  
- **營運指標調整**：公司將「Microsoft 365 Commercial cloud revenue growth」指標重新定義，將 Copilot 收入納入衡量雲端業務健康度的關鍵指標，顯示其在整體雲端策略中的核心地位【MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #142】。  
- **市場定位與成長驅動**：透過在 Microsoft 365 中加入 Copilot，Microsoft 期待在已成熟的安裝基礎上提升「每位使用者平均收入」與「座位滲透率」，同時向前線工作者與中小企業擴展 AI 功能，以捕捉新市場需求【MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #52】。  

總結來說，Microsoft 以 Copilot 為 AI 中樞，將其嵌入 Microsoft 365 各子服務與雲端訂閱，藉由提升使用者價值、推動座位與收入成長，並將其納入正式的營運指標，形成以 AI 為驅動的產品策略。

He said the company still sees room for growth, while also incorporating Microsoft’s Backup Express snapshot capability into its own backup stack. records.query: Microsoft 如何靠 Windows 帶動雲端與 Copilot 相關服務的參與度？
records.answer:
Microsoft 透過 Windows 作業系統的 OEM 授權與自有裝置（如 Surface）把使用者帶入雲端與 Copilot 服務的生態系，進而提升雲端收入與 AI 參與度。  

- Windows OEM 與 Devices 銷售直接產生 Windows 商業授權收入，Microsoft 以此為基礎推動 Azure、Microsoft 365 以及 Copilot 等雲端與 AI 方案，因為 Windows 為使用者安裝與執行這些服務的主要平台【57】。  
- 在「More Personal Computing」段落中，Microsoft 明確指出「Leveraging Windows to fuel our cloud business, grow our share of the PC market, and drive increased engagement with our services like Microsoft Edge, Bing, Copilot, Microsoft Teams, Microsoft 365 Consumer, Xbox Game Pass, and more」【49】。  
- Windows 商業授權（包括 Windows Commercial on‑premises）與雲端服務（Azure、Microsoft 365 Cloud、Microsoft 365 Copilot）在「Productivity and Business Processes」段落被列為同一收入來源，說明 Windows 與雲端、Copilot 之間的收入與使用者成長是相互促進的【52】。  
- Microsoft 在 10‑Q 報告中將「Windows OEM and Devices revenue growth」列為衡量「More Personal Computing」表現的關鍵指標，顯示公司持續追蹤 Windows 銷售對整體業務（包括雲端與 Copilot）貢獻的成長情況【101】、【103】。  

因此，Microsoft 以 Windows 作為入口，透過裝置預裝、授權捆綁與平台整合，驅動使用者採用 Azure、Microsoft 365 以及 AI‑driven Copilot，提升雲端服務的使用率與收入。

records.query: Amazon 在 AWS 基礎設施與 AI 領域（含與 Anthropic 的合作）的投資策略是什麼？
records.answer:
Amazon 正在採取「擴大 AWS 基礎設施 + 直接投資前沿 AI 企業」的雙軌策略，藉由持續加碼資料中心、伺服器與 AI/ML 相關硬體，同時透過對 Anthropic（以及 OpenAI）的股權與融資安排，將先進生成式 AI 能力深度整合進 AWS 服務中【AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #198】【AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #40】。

- **基礎設施與雲端資本支出**：Amazon 表示會持續提升「技術與基礎設施」支出，以支援 AI 與機器學習計畫，2025 年因基礎設施（含折舊與攤銷）增加而使相關成本上升，外匯因素亦額外增加 3.12 億美元（$312 million）【AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #215】；2026 年第一季較去年同期因基礎設施支出上升，外匯影響為 3.74 億美元（$374 million）【AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #78】。  
- **AWS 資產規模**：AWS 部門的資產從 2024 年 12 月 31 日的 1,559.53 億美元（$155,953 million） 增至 2025 年 9 月 30 日的 2,237.29 億美元（$223,729 million），顯示雲端基礎設施規模快速擴張【AMZN_10Q_202509.html, chunk #56】。同期間，AWS 的淨新增固定資產從 2024 年 Q3 的 143.41 億美元（$14,341 million） 增至 2025 年 Q3 的 283.01 億美元（$28,301 million），折舊與攤銷亦從 35.41 億美元（$3,541 million） 增至 56.48 億美元（$5,648 million），反映持續的資本投入【AMZN_10Q_202509.html, chunk #56】。  
- **AI 相關投資 – Anthropic**：在 2026 年第一季，Amazon 向 Anthropic 投入 50 億美元（$5.0 billion） 的非投票優先股，並與其簽訂一項最高 200 億美元（$20.0 billion）、於 30 個月後到期的融資設施，該設施在達成特定算力交付里程碑後可供 Anthropic 以可轉換債或上市後的普通股形式提取資金；同時 Amazon 仍保有最高 50 億美元（$5.0 billion） 的選擇權，可於未來的股權融資中進一步投資 Anthropic【AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #40】。  
- **AI 相關投資 – OpenAI**：Amazon 於 2026 年第一季投入 150 億美元（$15.0 billion） 的 Series C 優先股，並簽署承諾書，承諾在未來以最高 350 億美元（$35.0 billion） 的金額購買額外的 Series C 優先股或相等價值的普通股，直至 2028 年 12 月 31 日前完成或在 OpenAI 完成首次公開發行或直接上市時觸發【AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #40】。  
- **商業安排與 AI 芯片**：Amazon 亦調整了主要提供 AWS 雲端服務的商業安排，納入使用 AWS 晶片的合約義務，顯示其在自有 AI 加速器與晶片供應鏈上的投資與整合【AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #40】。  
- **長期策略說明**：公司在 10‑K 中指出，技術與基礎設施投資「支援廣泛的產品與服務」，包括 AI/ML、衛星寬頻與自動駕駛車輛，並預期未來支出將持續上升，以維持規模經濟與客戶體驗提升【AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #198】【AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #215】。  

綜合以上，Amazon 正以大幅資本支出擴張 AWS 資料中心與 AI 基礎設施，同時透過股權與融資工具直接佈局生成式 AI 企業（Anthropic、OpenAI），確保 AI 能力在其雲端平台內快速落地與商業化。

records.query: Amazon 在 AWS、Prime 與電商業務上面臨哪些反壟斷或監管風險？
records.answer:
Amazon 正在面臨多項與反壟斷及監管相關的風險，這些風險同時涵蓋其電商平台（包括實體店與線上商店、履約網路與 Prime 會員服務）以及 AWS 雲端服務。  

- **電商與 Prime 相關的競爭與消費者保護調查**：美國、加拿大與英國的州檢察長與聯邦貿易委員會等機構已對 Amazon 的店舖營運、履約網路、Prime 會員計畫以及其他電商服務提出「可能違反競爭或消費者保護規則」的調查，Amazon 正在激烈抗辯並準備依法防禦【AMZN_10Q_202509, chunk #108】、【AMZN_10Q_202603, chunk #113】、【AMZN_10K_2025, chunk #156】。  

- **AWS 雲端服務的競爭審查**：同樣的調查亦針對 AWS 的雲端服務提出競爭相關的疑慮，指出其可能違反反壟斷法規，Amazon 同樣表示將堅決抗辯【AMZN_10Q_202509, chunk #108】、【AMZN_10K_2025, chunk #156】。  

- **資料隱私與「門檻者」規範的合規成本**：隨著各國對資料收集、使用與披露的法律日益嚴格，Amazon 需面對不斷演變的隱私規範與「線上門檻者」新法規，這將提升合規成本並可能限制其業務運作【AMZN_10K_2025, chunk #156】。  

- **已提起的反壟斷與消費者保護訴訟**：自 2020 年以來，私人原告、州檢察長與 FTC 已在美國、加拿大與英國提起多起訴訟，指控 Amazon 涉及價格固定、濫用支配地位、壟斷或企圖壟斷、以及違反消費者保護法。這些訴訟要求「數十億美元」的損害賠償、三倍賠償金、懲罰性賠償、禁令、結構性改革、民事罰款以及律師費用等【AMZN_10K_2025, chunk #99】。  

- **潛在的財務與營運衝擊**：若上述調查或訴訟導致不利裁決，Amazon 可能面臨「巨額罰款」或「民事與刑事責任」，同時因合規成本上升、業務模式被迫調整、品牌聲譽受損以及成長受阻等因素，對其營運與財務表現產生實質影響【AMZN_10K_2025, chunk #156】。  

綜合以上，Amazon 在電商、Prime 以及 AWS 三大核心業務上皆受到反壟斷與監管機構的密切審查，相關訴訟與調查可能導致高額罰款、合規成本上升、業務限制以及聲譽風險。

In the U.S., most of Amazon’s motions to dismiss were granted in part, but in each case, at least some of the claims survived. records.query: Google 如何把 Gemini AI 整合進搜尋與其他產品生態系？
records.answer:
Google 把 Gemini AI 嵌入到搜尋、Google Workspace、雲端服務與多項消費者產品，讓這些服務能利用先進的多模態生成式模型提供更智慧的互動與資訊呈現【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #128】。  

- 在搜尋方面，Gemini 3 的增強推理能力被直接整合進 Search，支援視覺化與互動式使用者體驗，使搜尋結果更具上下文理解與生成式回應【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #128】。  
- Gemini 也以「Gemini app」的形式提供給使用者，讓使用者在專屬應用中直接體驗 AI 助手功能，同樣依賴同一套模型【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #128】。  
- 在企業與協作工具方面，Google 推出 **Gemini Enterprise** 供團隊在安全平台上建立與執行 AI 代理人，並在 **Gemini for Google Workspace** 中將 AI 能力注入 Gmail、Docs、Sheets、Slides 等雲端辦公應用，協助寫作、組織、視覺化與工作流程自動化【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #135】、【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #134】。  
- Google Cloud 透過 AI 基礎設施（包括自家 TPUs 與 GPU）提供 Gemini 相關的企業 AI 解決方案，如 **Vertex AI** 平台與 **Gemini Enterprise**，讓客戶在雲端環境中部署與使用 Gemini 模型【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #135】。  
- 此外，所有 15 個擁有超過五億使用者的產品（其中七個產品月活躍使用者達二十億）皆已使用 Gemini 模型，顯示 Gemini 已深度滲透至 Google 的整個產品生態系，包括 Android、Chrome、YouTube、Google Play、Pixel 裝置等【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #128】。  

透過上述多層面的整合，Google 讓 Gemini AI 成為搜尋、辦公、雲端與消費者服務的核心智慧引擎，提升產品的 AI 能力與使用者體驗。

The consolidated financial statements of Alphabet include the accounts of Alphabet and entities consolidated under the variable interest and voting models. Intercompany balances and transactions have been eliminated. Use of Estimates

Preparation of consolidated financial statements in conformity with GAAP requires us to make estimates and assumptions that affect the amounts reported and disclosed in the financial statements and the accompanying notes. Actual results could differ materially from these estimates due to uncertainties. On an ongoing basis, we evaluate our estimates, including those related to the allowance for credit losses; contingent liabilities; fair values of financial instruments and goodwill; income taxes; inventory; and useful lives of property and equipment, among others. We base our estimates on assumptions, both historical and forward looking, that are believed to be reasonable, and the results of which form the basis for making judgments about the carrying values of assets and liabilities. Revenue Recognition

Revenues are recognized when control of the promised goods or services is transferred to our customers, and the collectibility of an amount that we expect in exchange for those goods or services is probable. Sales and other similar taxes are excluded from revenues. Google Advertising

Google advertising revenues consist of revenues from:

Our customers generally purchase advertising inventory through Google Ads, Google Ad Manager, Google Display & Video 360, and Google Marketing Platform, among others. We offer advertising by delivering both performance and brand advertising. We recognize revenues for performance advertising when a user engages with the advertisement. For brand advertising, we recognize revenues when the ad is displayed, or a user views the ad. For ads placed on Google Network properties, we evaluate whether we are the principal (i.e., report revenues on a gross basis) or agent (i.e., report revenues on a net basis). Generally, we report advertising revenues for ads placed on Google Network properties on a gross basis, that is, the amounts billed to our customers are recorded as revenues, and amounts paid to Google Network partners are recorded as cost of revenues. Where we are the principal, we control the advertising inventory before it is transferred to our customers. Our control is evidenced by our sole ability to monetize the advertising inventory before it is transferred to our customers and is further supported by us being primarily responsible to our customers and having a level of discretion in establishing pricing. Google Subscriptions, Platforms, and Devices

Google subscriptions, platforms, and devices revenues consist of revenues from:

53. Alphabet Inc. •consumer subscriptions, which primarily include revenues from YouTube services, such as YouTube TV, YouTube Music and Premium, and NFL Sunday Ticket, as well as Google One, which offers access to our most capable Gemini models;

We report revenues from Google Play sales of apps and in-app purchases on a net basis because our performance obligation is to facilitate a transaction between app developers and end users for which we earn a service fee. Google Cloud revenues consist of revenues from:

•Google Cloud Platform primarily generates consumption-based fees and subscriptions for infrastructure, platform, and other services. These services provide access to solutions such as AI offerings including our enterprise AI infrastructure, Vertex AI platform, and Gemini Enterprise; cybersecurity offerings; and data and analytics solutions;

records.query: Google 搜尋如何演變出 AI Overviews 與 AI Mode 來回應生成式 AI 對搜尋的衝擊？
records.answer:
Google 搜尋透過加入 AI Overviews 與 AI Mode，利用 Gemini 大型語言模型的生成式 AI 能力，讓使用者能以自然語言提出更複雜的問題，並即時得到綜合且多模態的回應，以因應生成式 AI 對搜尋體驗的衝擊【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #132】。

- **AI Overviews**：在搜尋結果頁面直接提供「概覽」式的生成式回答，讓使用者只要輸入問題就能得到一段完整、可讀的說明，降低需要點擊多個連結的需求【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #132】。  
- **AI Mode**：在搜尋框內啟動「AI 模式」後，使用者可以提出更細緻、具多步驟的問題；系統會以 Gemini 的「先進推理、思考與多模態」能力，產出更具深度與互動性的回應，甚至支援圖像與文字的結合【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #132】。  
- **技術基礎**：這兩項功能皆建構於 Alphabet 全堆疊 AI 策略之上，核心是自家研發的 TPU 與 GPU 加速器以及最新的 Gemini 3 模型，確保在大規模運算下仍能提供即時回應【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #128】。  
- **商業考量**：Google 先以使用者體驗為主導推出這些功能，之後再探索不同的變現方式；同時也指出此舉是因應其他 AI 產品與服務供應商的競爭，避免搜尋收入被生成式 AI 取代【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #289】。  
- **產品覆蓋**：截至 2025 年，Alphabet 旗下 15 個半億級使用者的產品（其中 7 個產品擁有 20 億使用者）皆已整合 Gemini 模型，確保 AI Overviews 與 AI Mode 能在搜尋、YouTube、Google Workspace 等多個平台上一致運作【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #128】。  

總結來說，Google 搜尋以 AI Overviews 提供即時生成式摘要，以 AI Mode 允許更深入的多模態對話，兩者皆依賴自家 Gemini 系列模型與高效能算力基礎，從而在生成式 AI 時代保持搜尋的相關性與競爭力。

records.query: Meta 在 AI 與 Reality Labs 上的長期願景與投資方向是什麼？
records.answer:
Meta 的長期願景是打造「下一代計算平台」與以沉浸式體驗為核心的元宇宙，並透過 AI、穿戴裝置與虛擬/增強實境技術持續投入巨額資金【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #188】。

- **願景說明**：Meta 認為元宇宙（embodied internet）是社交科技的下一階段，旨在讓人們超越二維螢幕，享受沉浸式體驗，並以此作為未來計算平台的基礎【META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #72】、【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #175】。  
- **AI 投資方向**：公司將持續「開發與訓練 AI 模型」並「增加在新平台與技術的投資」，此為長期推動元宇宙與下一代介面的核心【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #188】。  
- **Reality Labs 投資規模與影響**：2025 年 Reality Labs 的投資已使整體營運利潤減少約 **191.9 億美元（$19.19 billion）**，且預期 2026 年的營運虧損將與 2025 年相似【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #188】。  
- **2026 支出分配**：Meta 計畫在 2026 年將 Reality Labs 營運費用的 **70%** 用於穿戴裝置（wearables）計畫，剩餘 **30%** 投入 VR 與 Horizon（元宇宙平台）【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #132】。

records.query: Meta 的廣告獲利模式與 Meta AI 在旗下 App 中扮演的角色是什麼？
records.answer:
Meta 的廣告獲利模式是透過在 Family of Apps（FoA）平台上銷售廣告版位，依展示次數（impression‑based）或使用者行動（action‑based）收費，並以「每則廣告平均價格」＝「總廣告收入 ÷ 投放廣告數量」計算單價；Meta AI 則在所有 App 中扮演 AI 助手與內容推薦引擎的角色，協助內容排序、個人化發現、廣告工具與新產品開發，提升使用者參與與變現效果。

- **廣告收入來源**：Meta 主要從 FoA 內的 Facebook、Instagram、Messenger、Threads、WhatsApp 以及第三方應用程式的廣告版位取得收入，廣告讓行銷人員能針對不同目標（如產生潛在客戶或提升品牌認知）觸及使用者【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #133】。  
- **收費方式**：廣告收入分為展示型（impression‑based）與行動型（action‑based）兩種，前者在廣告展示給使用者的合約期間確認收入，後者則在使用者完成點擊等行動時確認收入【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #311】。  
- **價格計算**：Meta 以「每則廣告平均價格」＝「總廣告收入 ÷ 投放廣告數量」來衡量每則廣告的平均價格，無論廣告客戶的目標是展示或行動【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #311】。  
- **廣告投放策略**：Meta 會根據產品（如影片、Reels、Feed、Stories）調整廣告的數量與頻率，並可隨時增減廣告投放以配合產品與變現策略的變化【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #311】。  

- **Meta AI 的定位**：Meta AI 是一個跨 App、獨立應用、AI 眼鏡與網路的 AI 助手，設計用來協助使用者學習、完成任務、創作內容與連結他人【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #128】。  
- **在產品中的功能**：Meta AI 支援內容排序（ranking）系統、AI 驅動的發現引擎（recommend relevant content），以及廣告工具的提升，這些都直接影響使用者參與度與廣告變現【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #128】。  
- **平台覆蓋**：Meta AI 在 Facebook、Instagram、Messenger、Threads、WhatsApp 等所有主要 App 中皆可使用，亦延伸至 AI 眼鏡等硬體產品【META_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #2】。  
- **投資與效益**：Meta 正在大量投資生成式 AI 與超級智慧，以增強內容推薦、廣告工具與新功能的開發，已在提升使用者參與與廣告變現上看到成效【META_10Q_202509.html, chunk #209】。  

總結來說，Meta 透過廣告版位的展示與行動收費模式創造主要營收，並利用 Meta AI 作為全平台的智能助理與內容推薦核心，提升廣告效率與使用者黏著度。

[META 10-K period 2025] Item 1.Business 

Overview

Our mission is to build the future of human connection and the technology that makes it possible. Our products enable people to connect and share through mobile devices, personal computers, virtual reality (VR) headsets, and AI glasses. We are innovating in artificial intelligence (AI) technologies to build transformative experiences and capabilities across our Family of Apps and new platforms, and to advance our vision to deliver personal superintelligence for everyone. We build technology that helps people connect and share, find and build communities, and grow businesses. We also help people discover and learn about what is going on in the world around them, enable people to share their experiences, ideas, photos, videos, and other content with audiences ranging from their closest family members and friends to the public at large, and stay connected everywhere by accessing our products. Meta is moving our offerings beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next computing platform. Our vision does not center on any single product, but rather an entire ecosystem of experiences, devices, and new technologies powered by AI. While the metaverse is in the very early stages of its development, we believe it will become the next computing platform and the future of social interaction. Across our work, we are innovating to build new experiences that help make our platform more social, useful, and immersive. Our AI investments support initiatives across our products and services, helping power the systems that rank content in our apps, our discovery engine that recommends relevant content, the tools advertisers use to reach customers, the development of new generative AI experiences, and the tools that make our product development more efficient and productive. We are also working to develop the next generation of AI models and advance our vision to build superintelligence, which we define as AI that surpasses human intelligence. Although it is inherently difficult to predict when superintelligence may be achieved, we are investing now because we believe this has the potential to begin a new era of individual empowerment, where people can direct superintelligence towards what they value in their own lives. Family of Apps Products

•Facebook. Facebook helps give people the power to build community and bring the world closer together. It's a place for people to share life's moments and discuss what's happening, nurture and build relationships, discover and connect to people with shared interests, and create economic opportunity. They can do this through Feed, Reels, Stories, Groups, Marketplace, and more. •Instagram. Instagram brings people closer to the people and things they love. Instagram Feed, Stories, Reels, Live, and messaging are places where people and creators can connect and express themselves through photos, video, and private messaging, and discover and shop from their favorite businesses. •Messenger. Messenger is a simple yet powerful messaging application for people to connect with friends, family, communities, and businesses across platforms and devices through text, audio, and video calls. •Meta AI. Meta AI is an assistant that's available across our apps, as a stand-alone app, on our AI glasses, and on the web. It's designed to help people learn, get things done, create content, and connect with others to make the most of every moment.

[META] It operates through two segments, Family of Apps (FoA) and Reality Labs (RL). The FoA segment offers Facebook, which enables people to build community through feed, reels, stories, groups, marketplace, and other; Instagram that brings people closer through Instagram feed, stories, reels, live, and messaging; Messenger, a messaging application for people to connect with friends, family, communities, and businesses across platforms and devices through text, audio, and video calls; Meta AI, an assistant that's available across apps, as a stand-alone app, on AI glasses, and on the web; Threads, an application for text-based updates and public conversations; and WhatsApp, a messaging application that is used by people and businesses to communicate and transact. The RL segment provides virtual and augmented reality products, including consumer hardware, software, and content that help people feel connected, as well as Meta Quest devices that enable social experiences across gaming, fitness, entertainment, and more. The segment also includes wearables such as AI glasses like Ray Ban Meta and Oakley Meta glasses; and the Meta Ray Ban Display, which combines AI glasses with an integrated lens display and the Meta Neural Band, a wrist worn device using electromyography that lets people control their AI glasses through neuromuscular signals. Meta Platforms, Inc. has a collaboration with Microsoft Corporation, NVIDIA Corporation, Advanced Micro Devices, Inc., Broadcom Inc., and OpenAI, L.L.C. The company was formerly known as Facebook, Inc. and changed its name to Meta Platforms, Inc. in October 2021. The company was incorporated in 2004 and is headquartered in Menlo Park, California.

[META 10-K period 2025] 70


Components of Results of Operations

Revenue

Family of Apps (FoA)

Advertising. We generate substantially all of our revenue from advertising. Our advertising revenue is generated by displaying ad products on Facebook, Instagram, Messenger, and third-party mobile applications. Marketers pay for ad products either directly or through their relationships with advertising agencies or resellers, based on the number of impressions delivered or the number of actions, such as clicks, taken by users. We recognize revenue from the display of impression-based ads in the contracted period in which the impressions are delivered. Impressions are considered delivered when an ad is displayed to a user. We recognize revenue from the delivery of action-based ads in the period in which a user takes the action the marketer contracted for. The number of ads we show is subject to methodological changes as we continue to evolve our ads business and the structure of our ads products. In particular, the ads we show may vary by product (for example, our video and Reels products are not currently monetized at the same rate as our Feed or Stories products), and from time to time we increase or decrease the number or frequency of ads we show as part of our product and monetization strategies. We calculate average price per ad as total advertising revenue divided by the number of ads delivered, representing the average price paid per ad by a marketer regardless of their desired objective such as impression or action. For advertising revenue arrangements where we are not the principal, we recognize revenue on a net basis.

[META 10-K period 2025] In particular, we regularly evaluate our product roadmaps and make significant changes as our understanding of the technological challenges and market landscape and our product ideas and designs evolve. Revenue and Investments

We report financial results for two segments: Family of Apps (FoA) and Reality Labs (RL). Currently, we generate substantially all of our revenue from selling advertising placements on our family of apps to marketers, which is reflected in FoA. Ads on our platform enable marketers to reach people across a range of marketing objectives, such as generating leads or driving awareness. Marketers purchase ads that can appear in multiple places including on Facebook, Instagram, Messenger, Threads, and WhatsApp, as well as third-party applications and websites. RL generates revenue from sales of consumer hardware products, software, and content.

[META 10-Q period 202509] In addition, competitive products and services have reduced some users' engagement with our products and services. We are investing in Reels and in AI initiatives across our products, including our AI-powered discovery engine to recommend relevant content, which we have already seen results in improved user engagement and monetization of our products. However, we continue to face competition from other products and services within certain demographics, in particular younger users. In addition, while Reels is growing in usage, it monetizes at a lower rate than our Feed and Stories products and we expect it will continue to monetize at a lower rate for the foreseeable future. We also have seen fluctuations and declines in the size of our active user base in one or more regions from time to time due to geopolitical conditions, which have adversely affected our user growth and engagement. These trends have adversely affected our advertising revenue and we expect will continue to adversely affect our advertising revenue in the foreseeable future. Although we regularly evaluate a variety of sources to understand trends in our advertising revenue, we do not have perfect visibility into the factors driving advertiser spending decisions and our assessments involve complex judgments about what is driving advertising decisions across a large and diversified advertiser base across the globe. Trends impacting advertising spend are also dynamic and interrelated. As a result, it is difficult to identify with precision which advertiser spending decisions are attributable to which trends, and we are unable to quantify the exact impact that each trend had on our advertising revenue during the periods presented. 34


Investment Philosophy

We remain focused on operating efficiently while investing in significant opportunities. In the nine months ended September 30, 2025, 83% of our total costs and expenses were recognized in FoA and 17% were recognized in RL. Our FoA investments include expenses relating to headcount, data centers, and technical infrastructure as part of our efforts to develop our apps and our advertising services. These efforts include significant investments in AI initiatives, including generative AI and superintelligence, to, among other things, recommend relevant content across our products, enhance our advertising tools, develop new products, and develop new features for existing products. In particular, we expect our AI initiatives will require significantly increased investment in infrastructure. We are also making significant investments in our metaverse and wearables efforts, including developing virtual, augmented, and mixed reality devices, software for social platforms, neural interfaces, and other foundational technologies. Our RL investments include expenses relating to technology development across these efforts.

records.query: Tesla 如何把自動駕駛（FSD/Autopilot）技術當作與競爭對手的核心差異化？
records.answer:
Tesla 把自動駕駛（FSD/Autopilot）作為與競爭對手的核心差異化，主要是透過以下幾個具體方式：

1. **全車系皆為自動駕駛設計**：Tesla 表示「每一台交付的 Tesla 車輛皆為設計自動駕駛」且認為其 AI 能力與進步「使我們與競爭者區別」​[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #31]。  
2. **自有 AI 與推論晶片**：公司使用自家設計的專屬推論晶片（in‑house custom designed inference chips）來訓練神經網路，讓視覺與感測技術在自動駕駛上具備獨特效能​[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #31]。  
3. **軟體全程內部開發與 OTA 更新**：Tesla 幾乎全部車載軟體（包括使用者介面、控制系統、資訊娛樂）皆由內部開發，並透過無線空中更新（over‑the‑air updates）持續提升 FSD 功能與安全性​[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #31]。  
4. **FSD 訂閱與 Robotaxi 服務**：公司將 FSD（Supervised）功能以訂閱模式銷售，並於 2025 年推出 Robotaxi 自動駕駛叫車平台，藉此把硬體技術轉化為 AI、軟體與車隊營運的服務驅動商業模式​[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #31]。  
5. **垂直整合與成本優化**：Tesla 強調其垂直整合的製造與供應鏈，持續降低製造成本，同時提供金融與租賃方案，讓 FSD 成為提升整體擁有成本競爭力的關鍵​[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #31]。  
6. **與傳統與新興競爭者的差異**：在 AI 與機器人領域，Tesla 承認面臨競爭，但其 Robotaxi 服務將與傳統叫車與計程車業者競爭，依賴持續的 FSD 與神經網路進步、Supercharger 網路與資訊娛樂服務來保持差異​[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #51]。  

綜合以上，Tesla 透過全車系自動駕駛設計、專屬 AI 晶片、完整內部軟體開發與 OTA 更新、以及將 FSD 轉化為訂閱與 Robotaxi 服務的模式，形成與其他電動車與傳統叫車公司的明顯技術與商業差異化。

[TSLA 10-K period 2025] We have planned electric vehicles to address additional vehicle markets, and will continue leveraging developments in our proprietary Full Self-Driving (“FSD”) (Supervised) features, battery cell and other technologies. For purposes of this filing, use of the term “FSD (Supervised)” includes the equivalent naming convention, “FSD (Capability)” that is used in the European, Middle East and Asia-Pacific regions. In June 2025, we launched our Robotaxi service, an autonomous ride-hailing platform that harnesses our technology and vehicles. We expect this service will open access to an expanded customer base as modes of transportation evolve, and, along with products such as FSD (Supervised) subscriptions, unlock the potential to advance a service-driven business model based on AI, software and fleet-based profits. Our Robotaxi business currently operates with Model Y vehicles but, in time, will include Cybercab, our purpose-built autonomous vehicle. Energy Generation and Storage

Energy Storage Products

Powerwall and Megapack are our lithium-ion battery energy storage products. Powerwall, which we sell and lease to customers, as well as through channel partners, is designed to store energy at homes or small commercial facilities. Megapack is an energy storage solution for commercial, industrial, utility and energy generation customers, multiple of which may be grouped together to form larger installations of gigawatt hours (“GWh”) or greater capacity. As AI infrastructure drives rapid load growth, Megapack helps to, among other things, increase utilization of existing generation and transmission capacity, resulting in a more efficient use of the electric grid. We also continue to develop software capabilities for remotely controlling and dispatching our energy storage systems across a wide range of markets and applications, including through our real-time energy control and optimization platforms for Megapack batteries (Autobidder) and distributed energy resources like Powerwall (Powerhub). Energy Generation Offerings

We sell energy generation systems directly to customers and also through channel partners. We design and manufacture certain components for our energy generation products, including solar panels and Solar Roof, which combines premium glass roof tiles with energy generation. We also purchase many components for our energy generation systems from various third-party manufacturers to provide for competitive pricing and adequate supply. Technology

Automotive

Self-Driving Development and Artificial Intelligence 

We use AI to develop real-world applications, such as autonomous driving solutions and robots. We utilize vision-based technologies, systems and software to train our artificial neural networks, which are accelerated by our own in-house, custom designed inference chips. We are also applying our artificial intelligence learnings from self-driving technology to Bots, such as Optimus, a general purpose, autonomous humanoid robot in development. Currently, we offer in our customer vehicles certain advanced driver assistance systems. Although at present, same as in the past, the driver is responsible for remaining fully engaged in the driving operation, these systems provide safety and convenience functionality that may relieve drivers of many tedious and potentially dangerous aspects of road travel much like the system that airplane pilots use, when conditions permit. As with other vehicle systems, we improve these functions in our customer vehicles through over-the-air software updates. Every Tesla vehicle delivered today is designed for autonomy, and we believe our capabilities and advancements in AI differentiate us from our competitors. Vehicle Control and Infotainment Software

The performance and safety systems of our vehicles and their battery packs utilize sophisticated control software. Control systems in our vehicles optimize performance, customize vehicle behavior, manage charging and control all infotainment functions. We develop almost all of this software, including most of the user interfaces, internally and update our vehicles’ software regularly through over-the-air updates, and work to actively improve our software security with every release. Battery and Powertrain

Our core vehicle technology competencies include powertrain engineering and manufacturing and our ability to design vehicles that utilize the unique advantages of an electric powertrain. We have designed our proprietary powertrain systems to be adaptable, efficient, reliable and cost-effective while withstanding the rigors of an automotive environment. We offer dual motor powertrain vehicles, which use two electric motors to maximize traction and performance in an all-wheel drive configuration, as well as vehicle powertrain technology featuring three electric motors for further increased performance in certain versions of Model S and Model X, Cybertruck and the Tesla Semi. We maintain extensive testing and R&D capabilities for battery cells, packs and systems, and have built an expansive body of knowledge on lithium-ion cell chemistry types and performance characteristics.

[TSLA 10-K period 2025] As we seek to become a top provider of autonomous solutions, we also face competition in the fields of AI and robotics. We expect our Robotaxi service to compete in this developing market, along with traditional ride-hailing and taxi services, through continued progress on our FSD (Supervised) and neural network capabilities, Supercharger network and infotainment offerings. Energy Generation and Storage

Energy Storage Systems

The market for energy storage products and services is also highly competitive, and both established and emerging companies have introduced products and services that are similar to our product portfolio or that are alternatives to the elements of our systems or software service offerings. We compete with these companies based on price, energy density, efficiency, optimization and performance. records.query: Tesla 在電動車市場面臨什麼樣的競爭態勢？
records.answer:
Tesla 在電動車市場面臨的競爭非常激烈，來自傳統內燃機車廠、新進電動車與混合動力車廠、以及自動駕駛與能源產品領域的多元對手，都可能削弱其銷售、價格與成長前景。  

- **傳統與新興汽車製造商的競爭**：Tesla 的 Cybertruck、Model S/X、Model 3/Y 分別與皮卡、豪華轎車、豪華 SUV、以及中小型轎車與緊湊 SUV 市場的傳統內燃機車型直接競爭；同時，許多已建立的汽車品牌以及新進廠商正積極推出電動、混合動力與插電式混合動力車型，擴大了電動車市場的競爭格局【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #50】。  

- **電池與原材料供應鏈風險**：Tesla 目前只能合格少量電池供應商，若供應中斷或原材料（鋰、鎳等）價格波動，將限制車輛與儲能產品的產量，迫使公司以更高成本採購或自行製造電池，進一步加劇與其他車廠在成本與產能上的競爭【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #62】。  

- **自動駕駛與 AI/機器人領域的競爭**：在發展 Robotaxi 服務與全自動駕駛（FSD）技術時，Tesla 必須與其他 AI、機器人公司以及傳統叫車與計程車服務競爭；若自動駕駛解決方案的採用率未如預期，亦可能因競爭者的技術突破而失去市場份額【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #51】【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #66】。  

- **能源儲存與發電產品的競爭**：Tesla 的 Powerwall、Powerpack 等儲能系統與太陽能發電產品面臨來自既有大型公用事業公司、其他儲能與太陽能廠商的價格與效能競爭；若公用事業或替代再生能源的零售/批發電價下降，Tesla 產品的吸引力可能受損【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #51】【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #66】。  

- **人才爭奪**：因為汽車與科技（含 AI）領域的人才市場極為競爭，若 Tesla 無法吸引或留住具備電動車、工程、AI 等專業技能的員工，將削弱其研發與生產能力，進一步影響在上述各市場的競爭力【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #78】。  

綜合上述，Tesla 必須同時應對傳統車廠與新興電動車廠的產品與價格競爭、供應鏈與原材料成本波動、AI/自動駕駛技術的創新競爭、能源產品的市場替代，以及高端人才的激烈爭奪，這些因素共同構成其在電動車市場的高度競爭態勢。

The worldwide automotive market is highly competitive today and we expect it will become even more so in the future. A significant and growing number of established and new automobile manufacturers, as well as other companies, have entered, or are reported to have plans to enter, the market for electric and other alternative fuel vehicles, including hybrid, plug-in hybrid and fully electric vehicles, as well as the market for self-driving technology and services and other vehicle applications and software platforms. In addition, certain government and economic incentives which provide benefits to manufacturers who assemble domestically or have local suppliers, may provide a greater benefit to our competitors, which could negatively impact our profitability. records.query: Tesla 的能源生成與儲能業務在公司整體策略中扮演什麼角色？
records.answer:
能源生成與儲能是特斯拉在推動清潔能源、生態系統整合與營收多元化的核心支柱【TSLA_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #2】。  

- **技術與產品互補**：特斯拉將汽車電池與電力電子的核心技術套用於能源儲存產品，採用模組化設計以提升製造彈性，並透過 Powerhub（分散式能源平台）與 Autobidder（電網交易平台）等軟體遠端控制與最佳化儲能系統【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #32】。  
- **太陽能與儲能整合**：2025 年開始量產住宅翻新太陽能板，並持續製造 Solar Roof，兩者皆設計與 Powerwall 整合，形成光伏＋儲能的完整解決方案【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #32】。  
- **市場定位與客戶取得**：能源生成與儲能產品透過官網、門市、畫廊及渠道合作夥伴銷售，強調「簡化、標準化、易於取得」以降低客戶取得成本，服務住宅、商業、工業及公用事業客戶【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #35】。  
- **營收貢獻**：2025 財政年度能源生成與儲能營收為 **127.71 億美元（$12,771 million）**，佔全年總營收 948.27 億美元（$94,827 million） 約 13.5%；2026 年第一季（截至 3 月 31 日）該業務營收為 **24.08 億美元（$2,408 million）**，顯示持續成長【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #148】【TSLA_10Q_202603.html, chunk #16】。  
- **策略性基礎設施**：特斯拉投資於 AI 訓練叢集（Cortex）與先進半導體，以支援大量車輛資料的神經網路訓練，這些計算資源同時強化能源儲存系統的智慧化與自動化，形成能源與自動駕駛技術的協同效應【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #32】。  

綜合以上，能源生成與儲能不僅是特斯拉減碳使命的實體落實，也是技術共享、產品互補、客戶拓展與收入來源多元化的關鍵戰略。

[TSLA 10-K period 2025] We also customize solutions including our energy storage products, energy generation systems and/or Solar Roof for customers to meet their specific needs. 4


Sales and Marketing

Historically, we have been able to achieve sales without relying on traditional advertising and at relatively low marketing costs. We continue to monitor our public narrative and brand, and tailor our marketing efforts accordingly, including through investments in customer education and advertising as necessary. Automotive

Direct Sales

Our vehicle sales channels currently include our website and a global network of company-owned stores. In some jurisdictions, we also have galleries to educate and inform customers about our products, but such locations do not transact in the sale of vehicles. We believe this infrastructure enables us to better control costs of inventory, manage warranty service and pricing, educate consumers about electric vehicles, make our vehicles more affordable, maintain and strengthen the Tesla brand and obtain rapid customer feedback. We reevaluate our sales strategy both globally and at a location-by-location level from time to time to optimize our sales channels. However, sales of vehicles in the automobile industry tend to be cyclical in many markets, which may expose us to volatility from time to time. Used Vehicle Sales

Our used vehicle business supports new vehicle sales by integrating the trade-in of a customer’s existing Tesla or non-Tesla vehicle with the sale of a new Tesla vehicle. The Tesla and non-Tesla vehicles we acquire as trade-ins, along with vehicles returned upon lease-end are subsequently remarketed, either directly by us or through third parties. Public Charging

We have a growing global network of Tesla Superchargers, which are our industrial-grade, high-speed vehicle chargers. Where possible, we co-locate Superchargers with our solar and energy storage systems to reduce costs and promote renewable power. Supercharger stations are typically placed along well-traveled routes and in and around dense city centers to allow vehicle owners the ability to enjoy quick, reliable charging along an extensive network with convenient stops. Use of the Supercharger network either requires payment of a fee or is free under certain sales programs. We offer Supercharger access to non-Tesla vehicles in support of our mission, with all major automakers announcing their adoption of the North American Charging Standard (NACS) in certain markets. We continue to monitor and increase our network of Tesla Superchargers in anticipation of future demand, including with respect to our Robotaxi services. We also work with a wide variety of hospitality, retail and public destinations, as well as businesses with commuting employees, to offer additional charging options for our customers, as well as single-family homeowners and multi-family residential entities, to deploy home charging solutions. To accelerate dependable charging ubiquity, Superchargers are also available through our Supercharger for Business program, where third parties can purchase and install Superchargers and set the charging price, while Tesla remains responsible for software updates, network operations, maintenance and driver support. In 2025, we opened the first Tesla Diner in California, which offers Supercharging as well as Tesla themed food and merchandise. In-App Upgrades 

As our vehicles are capable of being updated remotely over-the-air, our customers may purchase additional paid options and features through the Tesla app or through the in-vehicle user interface, which also allows us to offer certain options and features on a subscription basis. Energy Generation and Storage

We market and sell our solar and energy storage products to residential, commercial and industrial customers and utilities through a variety of channels, including through our website, stores and galleries, as well as through our network of channel partners, and in the case of some commercial customers, through PPA transactions. We emphasize simplicity, standardization and accessibility to make it easy and cost-effective for customers to adopt clean energy, while reducing our customer acquisition costs. 5


Service and Warranty

Automotive

Service

We provide service for our electric vehicles at our company-owned service locations and through Tesla Mobile Service technicians who perform work remotely at customers’ homes or other locations. Servicing the vehicles ourselves allows us to identify problems and implement solutions and improvements faster than traditional automobile manufacturers and their dealer networks. The connectivity of our vehicles also allows us to diagnose and remedy many problems remotely and proactively. Vehicle Limited Warranties and Extended Service Plans

We provide a manufacturer’s limited warranty on all new and used Tesla vehicles we sell directly to consumers, which may include limited warranties on certain components, specific types of damage or battery capacity retention. We also currently offer optional extended service plans that provide coverage after the new vehicle limited warranties end for certain models in specified regions. Energy Generation and Storage

We provide service and repairs to our energy product customers, including under warranty where applicable. We generally provide manufacturer’s limited warranties with our energy storage products and offer certain extended limited warranties that are available at the time of purchase of the system. If we install a system, we also provide certain limited warranties on our installation workmanship. For retrofit energy generation systems, we provide separate limited warranties for workmanship and against roof leaks, and for Solar Roof, we also provide limited warranties for defects and weatherization. For components not manufactured by us, we generally pass-through the applicable manufacturers’ warranties.

[TSLA 10-K period 2025] In order to enable a greater supply of cells for our products with higher energy density at lower costs, we have developed a new proprietary lithium-ion battery cell and improved manufacturing processes. Energy Generation and Storage

Energy Storage Products

We leverage many of the component-level technologies from our vehicles in our energy storage products. By taking a modular approach to the design of battery systems, we can optimize manufacturing capacity of our energy storage products. Additionally, our expertise in power electronics enables our battery systems to interconnect with electricity grids while providing fast-acting systems for power injection and absorption. We have also developed software to remotely control and dispatch our energy storage systems. Further leveraging our capabilities in AI, every Tesla energy storage product is capable of being enhanced through firmware updates and optimized by our software platforms, particularly Powerhub (for distributed energy resources, including Powerwall-enabled virtual power plants) and Autobidder (for Megapack batteries). Energy Generation Systems

We began manufacturing a new residential retrofit solar panel in 2025, and began initial customer deliveries in January 2026. We continue to manufacture Solar Roof, which has been engineered over numerous iterations to combine aesthetic appeal and durability with power generation. The efficiency of our energy generation products is aided by our own solar inverter, which incorporates our power electronics technologies. We designed both products to integrate with Powerwall. Infrastructure

To support our businesses in clean energy and transport and autonomous robots, we are investing in and developing the necessary supporting infrastructure. This includes additional compute hardware to better enable the massive amounts of field data captured by our vehicles to continually train and improve these artificial neural networks for real-world performance. In 2025, we further expanded Cortex, our training cluster at Gigafactory Texas, and announced a new collaboration with Samsung to manufacture advanced semiconductors for AI inference and training in the U.S. We are currently building Cortex 2 at Gigafactory Texas to further increase our AI training compute capacity. In 2026, we will be ramping six new production lines across vehicle, Bots, energy storage and battery manufacturing, while further leveraging our existing factory, charging and service center footprints to support future growth.

records.query: Apple 自己在 10-K 中如何描述它在智慧型手機、PC、平板市場面臨的競爭壓力與市佔地位？
records.answer:
Apple 在 2025 年的 Form 10‑K 中明確指出，**在全球智慧型手機、個人電腦（PC）與平板電腦（tablet）市場，Apple 只佔有「少數」的市場份額**，同時必須面對「激烈」的競爭壓力【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #24】。  

- **競爭者資源與規模**：Apple 認為其競爭者擁有「顯著的技術、行銷、分銷與其他資源」，以及「已建立的硬體、軟體與服務產品」與龐大的客戶基礎【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #24】。  
- **價格與毛利壓力**：市場「特別激烈」的因素包括「競爭者積極降價」以及「降低產品毛利」的行為，導致 Apple 必須在價格與性能上持續競爭【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #24】。  
- **產品與服務模仿**：Apple 提到競爭者會「模仿公司的產品特徵與應用」以提供更具競爭力的解決方案，且有些競爭者會「合作提供整合解決方案」或「在其產品中無縫嵌入相同元件」【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #24】。  
- **低價或虧損銷售**：部分競爭者具備「成本結構」或「資源」足以「以極低價格、甚至虧損的方式」提供產品與服務，進一步加劇價格競爭【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #24】。  
- **市場特性**：Apple 形容其所處的市場「高度競爭」且「價格競爭激烈、毛利向下壓力、產品性能持續提升、消費者與企業對價格敏感」；同時市場「頻繁推出新產品與服務、產品生命週期短、產業標準快速演變」【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #23】。  

綜合以上，Apple 在 10‑K 中將自己描述為在智慧型手機、PC 與平板領域僅佔少數市場份額，且必須持續應對資源充沛、價格激進、產品模仿與快速技術迭代等多重競爭壓力。
contexts: [AAPL 10-K period 2025] The Company’s ability to compete successfully depends heavily on ensuring the continuing and timely introduction of innovative new products, services and technologies to the marketplace. The Company designs and develops nearly the entire solution for its products, including the hardware, operating system, numerous software applications and related services. Principal competitive factors important to the Company include price, product and service features (including security features), relative price and performance, product and service quality and reliability, design and technology innovation, a strong third-party software and accessories ecosystem, marketing and distribution capability, service and support, corporate reputation, and the ability to effectively protect and enforce the Company’s intellectual property rights. The Company is focused on expanding its market opportunities related to smartphones, personal computers, tablets, wearables and accessories, and services. The Company’s products and services face substantial competition from companies that have significant technical, marketing, distribution and other resources, as well as established hardware, software, and service offerings with large customer bases. In addition, the Company faces significant competition as competitors imitate the Company’s product features and applications within their products to offer more competitive solutions. The Company also expects competition to intensify as competitors imitate the Company’s approach to providing components seamlessly within their offerings or work collaboratively to offer integrated solutions. Some of the Company’s competitors have broad product lines, low-priced products, large installed bases of active devices, and large customer bases. Competition has been particularly intense as competitors have aggressively cut prices and lowered product margins. Certain competitors have the resources, experience or cost structures to provide products and services at little or no profit or even at a loss. The Company has a minority market share in the global smartphone, personal computer, tablet and wearables markets, and some of the markets in which the Company competes have from time to time experienced little to no growth or contracted overall. Supply of Components

[AAPL 10-K period 2025] Europe includes European countries, as well as India, the Middle East and Africa. Greater China includes China mainland, Hong Kong and Taiwan. Rest of Asia Pacific includes Australia, New Zealand and those Asian countries not included in the Company’s other reportable segments. Although the reportable segments provide similar hardware and software products and similar services, each one is managed separately to better align with the location of the Company’s customers and distribution partners and the unique market dynamics of each geographic region. Markets and Distribution

The Company’s customers are primarily in the consumer, small and mid-sized business, education, enterprise and government markets. The Company sells its products and resells third-party products in most of its major markets directly to customers through its retail and online stores and its direct sales force. The Company sells its services in the same markets through its various service platforms. The Company also employs a variety of indirect distribution channels, such as third-party cellular network carriers and other resellers, for the sale of its products and certain of its services. During 2025, the Company’s net sales through its direct and indirect distribution channels accounted for 40% and 60%, respectively, of total net sales. Competition

The markets for the Company’s products and services are highly competitive and are characterized by aggressive price competition, downward pressure on gross margins, continual improvement in product performance, and price sensitivity on the part of consumers and businesses. The markets in which the Company competes are further defined by frequent introduction of new products and services, short product life cycles, evolving industry standards, and rapid adoption of technological advancements by competitors. Many of the Company’s competitors seek to compete primarily through aggressive pricing and very low cost structures, and by imitating the Company’s products and infringing on its intellectual property. Apple Inc. | 2025 Form 10-K | 2

[AAPL 10-K period 2025] Apple Inc. | 2025 Form 10-K | 7

Business Risks

To remain competitive and stimulate customer demand, the Company must successfully manage frequent introductions and transitions of products and services. Due to the highly volatile and competitive nature of the markets and industries in which the Company competes, the Company must continually introduce new products, services and technologies, enhance existing products and services, effectively stimulate customer demand for new and upgraded products and services, navigate global regulatory requirements and barriers to market access, and successfully manage the transition to these new and upgraded products and services. The success of new product and service introductions depends on a number of factors, including the Company’s ability to recruit and retain highly skilled personnel to execute on its strategic initiatives, and the timely and successful development and market acceptance of new products, services and technologies. Success also relies on the Company’s ability to manage the risks associated with new technologies and production ramp-up issues, the effective integration of third-party services and technologies into the Company’s products and services, the availability, delivery and performance of application software or other third-party support for the Company’s products and services, the effective management of manufacturing and other purchase commitments and the management of inventory levels in line with anticipated product demand, and the availability of products in appropriate quantities and at expected costs to meet anticipated demand. Additionally, quality issues or other defects or deficiencies can adversely affect the success of new product and service introductions and market acceptance. New products, services and technologies may replace or supersede existing offerings and may produce lower revenues and lower profit margins. The Company may not be able to successfully manage future introductions and transitions of products and services, which can materially adversely affect the Company’s business, reputation, results of operations, financial condition and stock price. The Company depends on component and product manufacturing and logistical services provided by outsourcing partners, many of which are located outside of the U.S. A significant majority of the Company’s manufacturing is performed in whole or in part by outsourcing partners located primarily in China mainland, India, Japan, South Korea, Taiwan and Vietnam, in addition to sourcing from partners and facilities located in the U.S. The Company relies on single-source partners in the U.S., Asia and Europe to supply and manufacture many components, and on partners primarily located in Asia, for final assembly of substantially all of the Company’s hardware products. The Company has also outsourced much of its transportation and logistics management.
